runtime.quote: **🔌 Bring your own model.** You are no longer limited to Codex or Claude. Point the collector at any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint — a hosted API, a local server, or your own gateway — right from the web panel. Add your `BASE_URL`, `MODEL`, and `API_KEY`, save, and switch between providers from a dropdown.
